prompt: Add rate limiting to the public API.

text: I will read the server entrypoint and config, then introduce a Redis-backed rate limiter.
Plan: add ioredis, a rate-limiter middleware, and mount it ahead of the API routes.

added.name: rateLimitMiddleware
added.signature: return async function rateLimitMiddleware(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {

text: The middleware needs a failure policy. Redis being a runtime dependency changes the request pipeline.

summary: Request pipeline changed: Client -> RateLimiter -> API, backed by Redis (ioredis).
Redis unavailability policy is unspecified: fail open or fail closed.

title: Redis unavailability policy
context: Rate limiting depends on Redis. What should happen when Redis is unavailable?

options.label: Fail open
options.description: Allow requests through when Redis is unavailable.

tradeoffs.consequence: API stays up during Redis outages.
Rate limits stop being enforced while Redis is down.
Outage is noisy to detect; monitoring must catch Redis downtime.

options.label: Fail closed
options.description: Reject requests with 503 when Redis is unavailable.

tradeoffs.consequence: A Redis outage takes down the public API.

text:
decision:
  redis_failure_policy: fail_open

evidence:
  - se-ratelimit-0002

instruction:
  Continue with fail-open behavior and keep the API available when Redis is down.
